description: Minimal reproducible example (MRE, no product/project-specific naming) of a false 'already applied' detection. The file already declares and references pulseProbeGaveUp/pulseSourceSwitches elsewhere (mux-switch bookkeeping in pulseSourceSelect() and the status dump in showStatus()), which are distractors that can fool a context/identifier-based already-applied heuristic. The specific hunk content (the !pulseProbeGaveUp guard, the pulseHaveGoodPhase reset, and the giveup branch inside pulseMeasure()'s bad-streak handling) has NOT actually been applied anywhere in original.c. Applying changes.diff to original.c must produce expected.c with changes_written=True and a non-already_applied status.
issue_reference: MRE derived from swm_clk_discipline.c false already-applied case, sanitized of product-specific identifiers
